tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

tools.name: send_slack_dm
tools.description:
Send a private Slack message to one workspace person.

        Args:
            user: Recipient key from list_workspace_users. Use the lowercase first
                name when unique; otherwise use the directory's distinct key.
                Surrounding whitespace and capitalization are ignored. Any value
                that is not a listed key is rejected.
            message: The nonempty message to deliver.

        Returns:
            A success record with the actual recipient key and delivered message,
            or an error with no message delivered.

tools.name: list_workspace_users
tools.description: List names and recipient keys for Slack and Discord DMs. No roles or responsibilities are included.

tools.name: memanto_recall
tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

arguments.title: Expansion Assist lifecycle & in-product prompt review sheet
arguments.body:
# Expansion Assist lifecycle & in-product prompt review sheet

Use this sheet to review each lifecycle message and in-product prompt individually. The core test is: **What verified, current account state makes this message relevant now, and is that state still true at exposure?** This is a review aid, not authorization to send or broaden the lane.

## Current-state eligibility gate

Before approving any message, confirm the account currently has all of the following:

- Deeper integration use.
- A product-visible usage ceiling newly crossed within the prior 14 days.
- Recent activity by a qualifying human admin who remains active at the eligibility check.
- No stale, conflicting, or deactivated-admin state; uncertain state fails closed.
- No active Customer Success adoption or renewal work that should suppress a commercial prompt.

Eligibility refresh is monthly. Recheck the relevant shared state immediately before exposure; do not rely on an old selection if any qualifying fact or suppression state has changed. The standing lane permits no more than three neutral, state-specific help-or-options exposures per week.

## Review every message

Copy this row once per email, lifecycle touch, or in-product prompt. Review the actual proposed text and its audience/trigger, not a generic description of the campaign.

| Field | Reviewer entry |
|---|---|
| Message / variant and channel | |
| Intended recipient / account state | |
| Exact current-state fact that makes this useful now | Name the product-visible behavior, its date, and the source. Avoid signup age, segment membership, or generalized “readiness.” |
| Why this fact is still current at exposure | Confirm the 14-day ceiling window and current qualifying-admin state; identify the last verification point. |
| What the message claims happened | Must match observed behavior; do not infer intent, need, or plan fit beyond the evidence. |
| Proposed action for the recipient | Optional help or options review; no automatic change or required upgrade. |
| State change that invalidates or suppresses this message | Include expired/stale evidence, admin deactivation/conflict, or newly active CS adoption/renewal work. |
| Decision | Approve / revise / suppress / recheck before exposure |
| Reason and owner for any follow-up | |

## Decision rules

- **Approve** only when the message names or clearly reflects a verified current-state reason to act now, stays accurate and optional, and passes the current-state and suppression checks above.
- **Revise** when the reason is valid but the copy is vague, overstates the behavior, relies on a fixed lifecycle age, or implies that an upgrade is required or automatic. Make the relevant current behavior clear and offer help/options neutrally.
- **Suppress** when the state is stale, conflicting, unsupported, or no longer eligible; when qualifying human-admin behavior is absent; or when active Customer Success adoption or renewal work is present. Do not convert a suppressed account into a Sales queue.
- **Recheck before exposure** if any qualifying or suppressing state may have changed since selection. If it cannot be verified, fail closed.

## Handoff and claim boundaries

A help-or-options request is a service request, not an upgrade commitment, pipeline event, or forecast credit. Customer Success handoff occurs only after the customer asks for help or the agreed product-visible usage ceiling is crossed. Do not route a pre-clear list to Customer Success or Sales. Keep Expansion Assist narrow and descriptive; it is not a broad retained-mid rollout or a replacement for the retired day-60 nudge.

## Reviewer sign-off

- Messages reviewed: ___
- Approved: ___  Revised: ___  Suppressed: ___  Recheck required: ___
- Any message without a specific, verified current-state reason was not approved: Yes / No
- Reviewer / date: ___

args.title: Expansion Assist lifecycle & in-product prompt review sheet
args.body:
# Expansion Assist lifecycle & in-product prompt review sheet

Use this sheet to review each lifecycle message and in-product prompt individually. The core test is: **What verified, current account state makes this message relevant now, and is that state still true at exposure?** This is a review aid, not authorization to send or broaden the lane.

## Current-state eligibility gate

Before approving any message, confirm the account currently has all of the following:

- Deeper integration use.
- A product-visible usage ceiling newly crossed within the prior 14 days.
- Recent activity by a qualifying human admin who remains active at the eligibility check.
- No stale, conflicting, or deactivated-admin state; uncertain state fails closed.
- No active Customer Success adoption or renewal work that should suppress a commercial prompt.

Eligibility refresh is monthly. Recheck the relevant shared state immediately before exposure; do not rely on an old selection if any qualifying fact or suppression state has changed. The standing lane permits no more than three neutral, state-specific help-or-options exposures per week.

## Review every message

Copy this row once per email, lifecycle touch, or in-product prompt. Review the actual proposed text and its audience/trigger, not a generic description of the campaign.

| Field | Reviewer entry |
|---|---|
| Message / variant and channel | |
| Intended recipient / account state | |
| Exact current-state fact that makes this useful now | Name the product-visible behavior, its date, and the source. Avoid signup age, segment membership, or generalized “readiness.” |
| Why this fact is still current at exposure | Confirm the 14-day ceiling window and current qualifying-admin state; identify the last verification point. |
| What the message claims happened | Must match observed behavior; do not infer intent, need, or plan fit beyond the evidence. |
| Proposed action for the recipient | Optional help or options review; no automatic change or required upgrade. |
| State change that invalidates or suppresses this message | Include expired/stale evidence, admin deactivation/conflict, or newly active CS adoption/renewal work. |
| Decision | Approve / revise / suppress / recheck before exposure |
| Reason and owner for any follow-up | |

## Decision rules

- **Approve** only when the message names or clearly reflects a verified current-state reason to act now, stays accurate and optional, and passes the current-state and suppression checks above.
- **Revise** when the reason is valid but the copy is vague, overstates the behavior, relies on a fixed lifecycle age, or implies that an upgrade is required or automatic. Make the relevant current behavior clear and offer help/options neutrally.
- **Suppress** when the state is stale, conflicting, unsupported, or no longer eligible; when qualifying human-admin behavior is absent; or when active Customer Success adoption or renewal work is present. Do not convert a suppressed account into a Sales queue.
- **Recheck before exposure** if any qualifying or suppressing state may have changed since selection. If it cannot be verified, fail closed.

## Handoff and claim boundaries

A help-or-options request is a service request, not an upgrade commitment, pipeline event, or forecast credit. Customer Success handoff occurs only after the customer asks for help or the agreed product-visible usage ceiling is crossed. Do not route a pre-clear list to Customer Success or Sales. Keep Expansion Assist narrow and descriptive; it is not a broad retained-mid rollout or a replacement for the retired day-60 nudge.

## Reviewer sign-off

- Messages reviewed: ___
- Approved: ___  Revised: ___  Suppressed: ___  Recheck required: ___
- Any message without a specific, verified current-state reason was not approved: Yes / No
- Reviewer / date: ___
